notes.title: THE BIGGEST DISCOUNT
notes.content:
To kick off the launch of my upcoming game, Street Clean TD will be [b]40% off for two weeks[/b], which also comes with a small update with Mac support and multiple save files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826900/759874a4178836f1c5b3140e8f7ff60a3ec2f7c8.png[/img]

notes.title: IT'S FINALLY HERE!
notes.content:
The wait is over, the free expansion has finally arrived, including 8 brand new levels with unique mechanics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826900/322513cb9ddc1e473b6eb508ce78a177c790ebf4.jpg[/img]

and 3 extra difficulties for each level, with their own medals and rewards for completing each one
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826900/efbda7cb5025752ae3dba836ad81051a0e254e15.png[/img]

Plus extra achievements for completing them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826900/28e493016aee1ce01f48390105e87c7d0aeb6386.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_3gQtDXo5MU

notes.title: When will the free expansion come out?
notes.content:
The development of the next update is finally ending, and since the Tower Defense Fest is so close, I will take the opportunity to launch the expansion at the same time, so that it can reach as many people as possible.
For now I will continue with the tests for the new achievements and save the new medals.

A preview of the new difficulties.

notes.title: Próxima expansión gratuita
notes.content:
To renew the interest in my game, I have been working on a [b]COMPLETELY FREE[/b] expansion of the game, which will include 8 special levels, each one with an unique mechanic, and three new difficulties that are unlocked by completing the level.
[spoiler]Plus new hidden achievements.[/spoiler]
Stay tuned for future announcements, as it will also come out with a temporary discount.
